coordinate_conventions.ball_projection_note: STRICT GROUND-PLANE PROJECTION (Z=0). Not a 3D ballistic model.

RAW.description: Direct homography projection with central difference velocities

POLYNOMIAL.description: Moving Savitzky-Golay / polynomial fit (degree 2, window size 5)

exp14_inconsistency_resolutions.k0_per_frame_clarification: TemporalPitchCalibrator max_keyframe_interval=1 checks age >= 1, triggering keyframes every 2nd frame (50% rate). True per-frame PnLCalib requires max_keyframe_interval=0.
exp14_inconsistency_resolutions.k1_caching_clarification: The reported 5.40 ms/frame was an in-memory caching artifact across loops. The true amortized compute cost is: (keyframe_rate * 260.0ms) + 10.75ms.
exp14_inconsistency_resolutions.unified_pipeline_latency_clarification: Low-latency live mode is ~54.76 ms (async) / ~80.76 ms (sync); quality mode is ~65.25 ms (async) / ~91.25 ms (sync). Neither guarantees >=25 FPS in strict synchronous execution.

selected_engine_specification.justification: Suppresses micro-jitter from 0.28m down to ~0.08m, guarantees causal continuous trajectories without batch delay, provides robust velocity estimation, and handles missing observations cleanly.
selected_engine_specification.export_format: Structured JSONL with frame-level entity observations and full provenance
